summary_en: FY7/26 period-end dividend raised to ¥26/share from ¥20/share forecast. Prior-year (FY7/25) paid ¥18/share. Revision reflects earnings outperformance versus initial guidance.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Period-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending July 2026
translation_en_brief: Bestone.Com resolved on 10 June 2026 to increase the FY7/26 (August 2025–July 2026) period-end dividend forecast from ¥20/share to ¥26/share, a 30% raise. The company cites earnings tracking ahead of initial guidance. The prior-year period (FY7/25) distributed ¥18/share. Full-year dividend (Q2 interim ¥0 + period-end ¥26) totals ¥26/share under the revised forecast. The company positions shareholder profit distribution as a core management priority.
